solar-energy-three-ways.alt: Three panels. Photovoltaic: sunlight strikes a blue panel and electricity flows to an inverter; light to electricity, no moving parts. Active solar heating: sunlight heats an orange roof collector; hot fluid flows to a tank and a pump returns it; pumps or fans move the heat. Passive solar design: low sun enters a house through a south-facing window below an overhang and warms a thick floor that stores heat; no pumps or fans. A note says windows face south in the Northern Hemisphere and north in the Southern Hemisphere.
